title: Universal property of the rational enveloping algebra
statement: Let $L$ be a rational Lie algebra [def-wf-lie-algebra], with no finite-dimensionality hypothesis, and set $U(L)=T_{\mathbf Q}(L)/(x\otimes y-y\otimes x-[x,y]:x,y\in L)$, where $T_{\mathbf Q}(L)=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}L^{\otimes n}$ is the tensor algebra and the quotient is by the two-sided ideal generated by the displayed relations. Let $\iota:L\to U(L)$ be the canonical linear map. For every unital associative rational algebra $A$ and rational linear map $f:L\to A$ satisfying $f([x,y])=f(x)f(y)-f(y)f(x)$, there is a unique unital rational algebra homomorphism $\widetilde f:U(L)\to A$ such that $\widetilde f(\iota(x))=f(x)$ for all $x\in L$.
